key.text: I want to make a phone stand for my desk out of wood. It should hold my phone at a slight angle, fit in my hand, and I only need one.

needs.why: To cut and shape wood into a phone stand

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Sketch the phone stand and check its sizes to fit your hand.

steps.title: Ask at the tool crib
steps.detail: Ask at the tool crib, which checks out hand and power tools.

steps.title: Assemble and finish
steps.detail: Sand the wood smooth so it is safe to touch.

routes.process: Cut and shape wood using the woodshop

warnings.fix: Keep the base thick enough to hold the weight of a phone.
warnings.issue: Wood parts can crack if cut too thin.

routes.fit_reason: The woodshop has saws and sanders to shape a small wooden stand. It suits a beginner who wants to work with wood.

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Plan the angles and dimensions for your phone stand.

steps.detail: Take the Level 1 orientation and safety training first, then the power tools training.

steps.title: Assemble and finish
steps.detail: Cut and sand the wood until it is smooth.

routes.process: Cut and shape wood using power tools

warnings.fix: Use solid pieces for the main structure.
warnings.issue: Power tools can splinter thin wood.

routes.fit_reason: The space provides power tools for cutting and sanding wood. It is a good fit for making a small desk stand.

routes.process: Cut and shape wood using woodworking machinery

warnings.fix: Cut a larger block first, then shape it.
warnings.issue: Small pieces are hard to hold against saws.

routes.fit_reason: The maker space includes woodworking machinery such as a table saw. This allows you to cut your stand from solid wood.
